Fetch Learner Profile.description: Fetches the authenticated learner's profile and forwards it to another endpoint.

Fetch Topic Tree By Kind.description: Fetches the content catalogue (topic tree), limited to one kind of node, and forwards it.

Fetch Topic Exercises.description: Lists the exercises within a topic, e.g. to map curriculum content into a learning management system.

Fetch Topic Videos.description: Lists the videos within a topic and forwards them.

Fetch Single Exercise.description: Retrieves one exercise by its name.

Fetch Badges.description: Lists all badges, for tracking learner achievements in a programme dashboard.
